stories.title: Pickett not budging on No. 5 amid Daniels-LSU flap

stories.title: Source: Beck out, derailing rematch vs. Mendoza
stories.summary: Cardinals quarterback Carson Beck won't play in Thursday night's preseason game against the Raiders due to a rib injury sustained in last Thursday's Hall of Fame Game, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: More Fever players back White after coach booed
stories.summary: Fever All-Stars Aliyah Boston and Kelsey Mitchell supported coach Stephanie White on Thursday, saying they were disappointed by the boos during White's introduction at Tuesday's home game.
